rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Joachim du Bellay ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard Sauvageot (France, 2004).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2005.
rows.Bloom: White, pink center. Mild fragrance. up to 70 petals. Medium, very full (41+ petals), cupped, old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Dense, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Note: The ARS approved exhibition name is Joachim du Bellay (without "Sauvegeot Floribunda")
